name: Tasly Pharmaceuticals, Inc
old_description: At Tasly Pharmaceuticals Inc. (TPI), we are dedicated to delivering effective, safe, and highquality botanical medicines that complement modern medical practices. Our innovative solutions provide a synergistic approach to healthcare, offering patients alternative and long-term treatment options while working alongside conventional medicine.
about:
Tasly Pharmaceuticals, Inc. was founded in 2006 and is headquartered in Rockville, Maryland. The company was established to integrate botanical science with modern pharmaceutical innovation, developing safe, effective, and scientifically validated botanical medicines that complement conventional treatments.

The company develops and manufactures botanical drugs, most notably T89 (Dantonic), the first herbal medicine-derived compound to complete an FDA Phase III global clinical trial. Production runs on what Tasly describes as the world's largest proprietary automatic dripping pill and packaging line, a fully automated system that handles feeding, precision pill counting, labeling, real-time imprint monitoring, and automated removal of non-conforming units. The line operates under global digital control. Supporting processes include extraction, condensation, chromatography, crystallization, filtration, and drying, governed by Good Extracting Practice standards. Tasly holds more than 500 regulatory approvals worldwide.

Tasly serves the pharmaceutical and healthcare sectors, focusing on cardiovascular indications such as stable ischemic heart disease and chronic stable angina, and metabolic conditions like hyperlipidemia. Clinical programs include the ORESA and CAESA trials; Phase III data were presented at the American College of Cardiology meeting. Collaboration partners have included the Trade Winds ASEAN Mission and BioJapan, indicating a global commercial and research orientation.

The company differentiates itself through an end-to-end quality system spanning Good Manufacturing Practice, Good Agricultural Practice for raw-material cultivation, Good Extracting Practice, and Good Laboratory Practice. This integrated approach, combined with the proprietary automated line, aims to ensure batch-to-batch consistency and bridge traditional botanical knowledge with modern pharmaceutical validation.
